_readme: Bounded input packet for the puzzle-solving spike (docs/ZELDA_AGENT.md's isolated-reasoning design). Every field here is either a directly observed fact (RAM/tilemap read, or a dialogue transcript read from the emulator) or explicitly marked as unconfirmed. A hypothesis may cite ONLY entities that appear in this file -- zelda_puzzle_validator.rb enforces that mechanically. Object descriptions are deliberately semantic-free (position + tile IDs, not 'this looks like a bush') to avoid smuggling in pattern-matched guesses from outside knowledge.
